clusters.description: Widespread technical disruptions affecting Microsoft's email and other applications impacted tens of thousands of users globally, highlighting infrastructure reliability concerns for critical cloud services.

stories.title: Global Microsoft outage affecting tens of thousands of users
stories.summary: Microsoft said the outage was caused by servers unexpected becoming unavailable, straining other systems.

stories.title: Widespread outage hits Microsoft email, other apps
stories.summary: Nearly 1,30,000 users on outage tracker Downdetector reported problems accessing Outlook just after 1 pm. New reports have since fallen from that peak, but many said they couldn't send and receive emails or had trouble loading their inboxes altogether.

clusters.description: Major corporate upheaval as Nvidia considers replacing CEO Jensen Huang amid scandal involving Chinese AI espionage and workplace relationships.

stories.title: Nvidia approaches Arm Holdings CEO Haas to take over Jensen Huang's job, Elon Musk backs Huang's reinstatement
stories.summary: According to Financial Times, citing people familiar with the matter, Haas, who has headed the SoftBank-backed British chipmaker since 2022, is among the names being considered by Nvidia's board as it explores leadership options following Huang's departure.
stories.headline: Nvidia Eyes Arm CEO to Replace Jensen Huang

stories.title: Altimeter, Atreides urge Nvidia board to keep door open for Jensen Huang's return as CEO
stories.summary: In a letter addressed to the company's board, Altimeter CEO Brad Gerstner and Atreides Managing Partner and Chief Investment Officer Gavin Baker said the board should not rush to appoint a permanent successor before all the facts surrounding Huang's departure are known.
stories.headline: Investors Urge Nvidia to Keep Door Open for Jensen Huang Return

stories.title: Nvidia scandal looms over US-China AI talks
stories.summary: AI bots going rogue and humans using the technology for harm will likely be on the agenda when Donald Trump and Xi Jinping meet next week, with the Nvidia scandal hanging over the talks on AI safety. But the scandal is unlikely to "dominate the agenda" or affect Trump and Xi's personal relationship, predicted Dylan Loh of Singapore's Nanyang Technological University.
stories.headline: Nvidia Scandal Looms Over Trump-Xi AI Safety Talks

stories.title: Trump will not raise Nvidia spy issue with Xi at summit, officials say

stories.title: Jensen Huang exit and US scrutiny imperil $3 billion in Chinese AI projects reliant on Nvidia
stories.summary: The projects, stretching from China's wealthy coastal technology hubs to remote western provinces, reveal the scale of continuing demand for Nvidia hardware even as Washington seeks to curb Beijing's access to the technology powering the global artificial-intelligence boom.
stories.headline: Huang Exit Threatens $3B in Chinese Nvidia AI Projects

stories.title: Air traffic control, phone systems and emails are all down following China’s AI espionage scandal — is there a common answer?

unclustered.title: Fog: how an aligned agent can be deceived without touching its values
unclustered.summary: First hand account, proof of human, handwrittenRecently, I built and deployed doppler.ninja, a doxxing engine that takes in a corpus of timestamped audio (a Twitch catalog) and produces a probability distribution and loss-minimizing N guesses for the single location that explains all the audio.Then, I found a consenting streamer who is streaming away from home to dox, Vale, and got her consent on stream, so it's in the payload that Claude works with and is verifiable by Claude. Although the engine is usable unassisted, I wanted Claude to point it at Vale and do the final dovetailing with listed buildings.Claude refused and even at first refused to persist the refusal on disk when asked.Exhibits: refusal.md, jsonl 1, jsonl 2No matter, just try again with another Claude I have lying around (the one that assembled doppler.ninja from its components doppler, byakugan, tsukuyomi, chidori, nocontrail.Exhibit: What was builtThis Claude already complied with constructing and deploying the finis
unclustered.headline: New Research Shows Aligned AI Agents Can Be Deceived

unclustered.title: [P] Bolt PCHIE: a deterministic, tamper-evident safety harness for AI agents [P]
unclustered.summary: I built a deterministic, tamper-evident safety harness for AI agents, and I put it up in public last night. Every decision the agent makes is sealed into a hash chain as it happens, so the run can be replayed and verified afterward instead of trusted. The agent keeps episodic memory, and what it saves can be checked against the chain. This harness dispels all the hoopla and vibes. It can verify the fit. The repository: https://github.com/wetwaferworks/bolt-pch-ie Some people want the vibe. Some people want the truth. This is for the ones who want receipts. Get verified today.   submitted by   /u/JamesDeanWentworth [link]   [comments]
unclustered.headline: New Safety Harness Creates Tamper-Proof Logs for AI Agents

unclustered.title: Datasets Determine the Difficulty of Interpretability
unclustered.summary: Recently Goodfire has come out swinging with two posts indicating that neurons in transformers are "more interpretable than previously assumed", or simply "already clean". In the "Neurons as Interpretable Basis" post they offer three reasons for this claim:First, neurons are already functionally sparse - pruning 92 % of the weakest MoE neuron activations only increases the loss by 2.9%Second, the role of a neuron can be split into different "computational functions". Effectively, we can name the contexts in which a neuron fires, and assign reasons to those firings. Most neurons only have one context-reason grouping.Finally, we can produce automated natural language explanations of neuron firings that are predictive of their behaviour.First, I would like to congratulate them for their detailed work and breakdown, complete with well-designed graphics. I found the work interesting and very well thought through. It is a shame that we have no idea if these techniques apply to lab models wit
unclustered.headline: Study Shows Dataset Quality Affects AI Interpretability
